package sharestore

// TEST ONLY — NEVER FUND. Run only in an archive of the pinned old Co-Signer.
import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/BroLabel/brosettlement-mpc-co-signer/internal/contract/mpc2of3"
	core "github.com/BroLabel/brosettlement-mpc-core/tss"
)

func TestProduceFrozenLegacyArtifacts(t *testing.T) {
	corpus, output := os.Getenv("LEGACY_CORE_CORPUS"), os.Getenv("LEGACY_ARTIFACT_OUTPUT")
	if corpus == "" || output == "" {
		t.Fatal("explicit synthetic corpus and new output required")
	}
	if err := os.Mkdir(output, 0700); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	read := func(path string) []byte {
		b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return b
	}
	write := func(path string, b []byte) {
		if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, path), b, 0600); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	hash := func(b []byte) string { v := sha256.Sum256(b); return hex.EncodeToString(v[:]) }
	manifestBytes := read(filepath.Join(corpus, "manifest.json"))
	var source struct {
		Warning, ChainCode, RootPublicKey string
		Participants                      []struct{ PartyID, Blob, SHA256 string }
		Children                          []struct{ Path, PublicKey string }
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(manifestBytes, &source); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if source.Warning != "TEST ONLY — NEVER FUND" {
		t.Fatal("not a synthetic K01 corpus")
	}
	keyID, sessionID, keyRef := "mpc_key_123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000", "synthetic-legacy-dkg", "legacy-v1-public-test-only-key"
	key := sha256.Sum256([]byte("TEST ONLY — NEVER FUND: legacy artifact AES key"))
	encodedKey := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(key[:])
	provider, err := NewKeyProvider(encodedKey, keyRef)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	chain, err := hex.DecodeString(source.ChainCode)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	descriptor := []byte(`{"algorithm":"ECDSA","chainCodeHash":"` + mpc2of3.ChainCodeHashFor(chain).String() + `","curve":"secp256k1","derivationScheme":"bip32_secp256k1","descriptorKind":"mpc-key-descriptor","descriptorVersion":1,"keyId":"` + keyID + `","parties":[{"partyId":"mpc-signer","purpose":"platform"},{"partyId":"co-signer-primary","purpose":"primary"},{"partyId":"co-signer-recovery","purpose":"recovery"}],"protocolVersion":1,"publicKeyFormat":"compressed_sec1","threshold":2}`)
	_, fingerprint, err := mpc2of3.ParseCanonicalDescriptor(descriptor)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var stores []*Store
	for _, purpose := range []StorePurpose{StorePurposePrimary, StorePurposeRecovery} {
		dir := filepath.Join(output, string(purpose))
		if err := os.Mkdir(dir, 0700); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		cfg, err := NewStoreConfig(purpose, dir, provider)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		store, err := OpenStore(cfg)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		stores = append(stores, store)
	}
	pair := NewActivePair()
	lease, err := pair.RegisterPair(PairRegistration{SessionID: sessionID, KeyID: keyID, PrimaryPartyID: primaryPartyID, RecoveryPartyID: recoveryPartyID, DescriptorBytes: descriptor})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer lease.Release()
	writer, err := NewRoutingWriter(pair, stores[0], stores[1])
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	artifacts := []map[string]any{}
	for _, participant := range source.Participants {
		if participant.PartyID == "mpc-signer" {
			continue
		}
		blob := read(filepath.Join(corpus, participant.Blob))
		if hash(blob) != participant.SHA256 {
			t.Fatal("K01 blob hash mismatch")
		}
		fp := [32]byte(fingerprint)
		if err := writer.SaveShare(context.Background(), core.SaveShareInput{SessionID: sessionID, KeyID: keyID, LocalPartyID: participant.PartyID, OpaqueDescriptorFingerprint: fp[:], CodecBlob: blob}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		purpose := "primary"
		if participant.PartyID == recoveryPartyID {
			purpose = "recovery"
		}
		file := purpose + "/" + keyID + "." + purpose + ".json"
		envelopeBytes := read(filepath.Join(output, file))
		var envelope artifactEnvelopeV1
		if err := json.Unmarshal(envelopeBytes, &envelope); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ciphertext, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(envelope.Encryption.Ciphertext)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		artifacts = append(artifacts, map[string]any{"partyId": participant.PartyID, "purpose": purpose, "file": file, "sha256": hash(envelopeBytes), "ciphertextSHA256": hash(ciphertext), "blobSHA256": participant.SHA256, "fingerprint": mpc2of3.ArtifactFingerprintFor(envelopeBytes).String()})
	}
	write("descriptor.json", descriptor)
	write("core-manifest.json", manifestBytes)
	producers := map[string]string{}
	for _, file := range []string{"go.mod", "go.sum", "internal/sharestore/artifact.go", "internal/sharestore/routing_writer.go", "internal/sharestore/publisher.go", "internal/sharestore/fs_linux.go"} {
		producers[file] = hash(read(filepath.Join("..", "..", file)))
	}
	manifest := map[string]any{"warning": source.Warning, "coSignerRevision": "cf48fe4a51cc1adcff0c3994d124a0d59f7ae12c", "coreVersion": "v0.5.0", "tssVersion": "v1.5.0", "sourceKeyId": "synthetic-legacy-v1-never-fund", "keyId": keyID, "sessionId": sessionID, "keyRef": keyRef, "encodedKey": encodedKey, "descriptorSHA256": hash(descriptor), "coreManifestSHA256": hash(manifestBytes), "rootPublicKey": source.RootPublicKey, "chainCode": source.ChainCode, "children": source.Children, "artifacts": artifacts, "producerSHA256": producers}
	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(manifest, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write("manifest.json", append(b, '\n'))
	input := map[string]any{"version": 1, "keyRef": keyRef, "encodedKey": encodedKey, "keyId": keyID, "sessionId": sessionID, "descriptorBase64": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(descriptor), "primaryDirectory": filepath.Join(output, "primary"), "recoveryDirectory": filepath.Join(output, "recovery")}
	b, err = json.MarshalIndent(input, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	write("proof-input.json", append(b, '\n'))
}
